content: Current Iron Realms Nexus GMCP documentation lists Core, Char, Char.Items, Char.Skills, Room, IRE.Display, and IRE.Target modules. It documents IRE.Target.Set and IRE.Target.Info with id, short_desc, and hpperc; Char.Items provides inventory and room item list/update messages; Char.Skills.Get requests groups, group lists, or specific skill info. For boop, continue to drive targeting, room state, skill gating, and rage/target metadata from GMCP while keeping text-trigger fallbacks for Achaea-specific combat lines.
